note: Captured 2026-10-28 with headless Chrome. Phone numbers and e-mail addresses on the page were replaced by bullets before capture. Desktop images are 1440px wide (1x, supersampled from a 2x render) with chunk height <= 2000; *-hero@2x.webp are 2880x1800. Mobile images are 780px wide (390 css px at 2x). kind: chunk = full-page slice, scene = viewport capture of a scroll-driven section, composite = reassembled page, ui-state = hover/modal/accordion state, brand = identity asset. Page copy is Catalan (the site also has /es/). Scene entries carry scrollY = the window scroll position (css px) at which the viewport capture was taken.
